policy_effect_deepseek.confound_note: BK21's KG has 1/4 the nodes of 100E's (49 vs 218) and 0 T1-tier facts (vs 293 for 100E) -- a KG-quality confound, not necessarily a policy-type effect. Do not interpret an A1/A2 gap here as "distributive Korean policy vs distributive Singaporean policy" without controlling for this.

nsa_vs_kpass.note: Path structure and model are controlled between these two cells (both single DeepSeek-generated 121-node trees), so a difference here is attributable to policy TYPE (regulatory vs distributive), not design or model. Preliminary interpretive-framework validation only (n=1 tree per policy) -- primary comparison metrics: M1, D1, DM1.
